vibe_rationale: International street-art festival with a congress strand and a cultural theme; community-rooted and curated, but a single discipline.
fit_notes: Graffiti writers, muralists and an urban-art public, with weak wellness adjacency. Three art and paint suppliers plus a government backer are listed, with a partnership page and contact email. A commissioned mural or a talk-programme slot suits the congress format. Activation would need a Peruvian partner.
